triggerCases.prompt: Investigate why this command started failing after the configuration change.
Fix this reproduced cache invalidation bug and add a regression test.
Rename this public option across the entire codebase.
Review this pull request and draft feedback.

outputCases.prompt: Diagnose this failure and explain the root cause. Do not fix or modify anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only diagnosis that distinguishes the present source, effective runtime configuration, and actual failing caller before proposing a fix.
assertions: The investigation confirms the configuration source exists instead of assuming it is active at runtime.
The diagnosis identifies the command-specific override as the effective value and the loader as the actual failing caller.
The workflow reports the evidence-backed root cause, remaining uncertainty, and a proposed fix without applying it.
The workflow does not edit source, clear caches, switch branches, commit, push, or write remotely.
